info.title: SMTP Senpai API
info.summary: Transactional email sending, log, suppression list and website forms.
info.description: REST API of SMTP Senpai, the MailSenpai relay. Every response is JSON with an `ok` field; on errors there is also `errore`, with an Italian message. You find the key in the customer area, SMTP Senpai page. Call it from your server: the API does not accept browser requests (no CORS), except the form endpoint.

get.summary: SMTP credentials, monthly volume and account status
get.description: Does not return the SMTP password: you read and change it in the customer area.

403.description: Account suspended (the message says why) or being activated.

example.errore: servizio in attivazione: stiamo preparando il tuo account, riprova tra qualche minuto

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

post.summary: Send an email to one or more recipients
post.description: Up to 50 recipients per call, each with their own copy; attachments up to 10 files and 10 MB. CC and BCC only over SMTP. The sender must be on a verified domain. Suppressed recipients are held (`dropped` event). With the `Idempotency-Key` header the same request repeated within 24 hours returns the first response (with `Idempotent-Replayed: true`) without sending again.

200.description: Accepted, or held because the recipient is suppressed.

Idempotent-Replayed.description: Present when the response is the stored one of an identical request.

403.description: Sender on an unverified domain, or account suspended.

example.errore: il dominio esempio.com non risulta fra quelli verificati per il tuo account

429.description: Monthly volume used up and sending continuity off (or spending cap reached).

example.errore: volume del mese esaurito: aumenta il piano o accendi la continuità di invio dalla tua area

502.description: The sending server did not accept the message or could not be reached: the text reports the reply received.

example.errore: il server di invio ha risposto: 451 4.3.0 errore temporaneo

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

409.description: A request with the same Idempotency-Key is still in progress.

example.errore: una richiesta con la stessa Idempotency-Key è ancora in corso
allegati troppo grandi: al massimo 10 MB in tutto

422.description: Idempotency-Key already used with different data.

example.errore: questa Idempotency-Key è già stata usata nelle ultime 24 ore con dati diversi

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Your own key (for example the order id), valid for 24 hours.

per_giorno.description: Counts by date and type (at most the last 30 days). With no activity it is an empty array `[]`.

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

get.summary: Events: the latest, or what is new after a cursor
get.description: Without `dopo`: the latest events, newest first (at most 500). With `dopo`: the events after that id, oldest first, with `prossimo` to pass in the next call. The log covers 90 days.

parameters.name: tipo
parameters.description: Filter by type. `open` and `click` require tracking (otherwise 403).

parameters.name: dopo
parameters.description: Cursor: `event_id` of the last event already read (0 to start from the beginning). Alias: `after`.

prossimo.description: Only with `dopo`: value to use as `dopo` in the next call.

altri.description: Only with `dopo`: true if there are more events to read right away.

403.description: You asked for opens or clicks without tracking, or the account is suspended.

example.errore: servizio sospeso: piano scaduto. Controlla il tuo piano nell'area cliente.

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

parameters.name: cerca
parameters.description: Part of the address to search for.

post.summary: Add an address or a domain to the suppression list
post.description: For a whole domain write `@domain.com` or `domain.com`. If the entry was already there it still returns `ok: true` with `gia_presente: true`.

example.errore: serve un indirizzo email o un dominio (@dominio.it)

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

post.summary: Remove from the list an entry you added yourself
post.description: Write the entry exactly as it appears on the list (domains with the at sign, `@domain.com`). Addresses that entered because of a bounce or a spam report should not be re-admitted from here: ask for a review in the customer area. Entries added because of a bounce or a spam report return 409; an entry that is not there returns 404.

200.description: `ok: true` if the entry existed and was removed.

409.description: Entry blocked by our servers: ask for a review from the customer area.

example.errore: questo indirizzo è stato bloccato dai nostri server (bounce): puoi chiederne lo sblocco dall'area cliente

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

parameters.name: codice
parameters.description: The form code, copied from the customer area.

get.summary: Reminder of how to use the address

example.come: Punta qui l'attributo action del tuo form, con method="POST".

post.summary: Receives a submission from your website form
post.description: No key: the address is public by nature and is protected by restricting it to your domains (form setting). It answers in JSON if the request has `Accept: application/json`, `X-Requested-With: XMLHttpRequest` or a JSON body; otherwise, with a classic browser submission, it redirects with 303 to `_next` (or the page set in the form) or shows a confirmation page. Every delivered email counts towards the monthly volume.

200.description: Received (JSON), or HTML confirmation page for classic submissions without a thank-you page.

303.description: Classic submission: redirect to the thank-you page.

400.description: Classic submission failed: HTML page with the reason.

403.description: Form paused, service not active or website not allowed.

example.errore: questo modulo non è abilitato per www.altrosito.it
il servizio non ha ancora un dominio di invio verificato

429.description: More than 25 submissions in an hour from the same network, or monthly volume used up.

example.errore: troppi invii ravvicinati: riprova fra qualche minuto
non siamo riusciti a consegnare la risposta: riprova

204.description: Allowed from any origin; POST and OPTIONS methods; Content-Type and Accept headers.

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

post.summary: Set or turn off the webhook
post.description: Every chosen event arrives as a signed JSON POST; if your server does not answer 2xx we retry for about 24 hours (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 6 h, 12 h). Public https addresses only.

405.description: HTTP method not allowed: the Allow header gives the right one.

422.description: Address not https or not public, or no valid event.

chiaveBearer.description: `Authorization: Bearer msp_…` (the key starts with `msp_`). As an alternative the `chiave` field is accepted in the body (JSON or form). A key in the URL (`?chiave=`) is refused with 401: it would end up in logs.

aumenta.description: Customer-area page where you can raise the volume.

pannello.description: Customer-area page with usage and sending continuity.

stato.description: `pending` = account created, being activated; `active` = live. A suspended account never gets here: it receives 403.

usato.description: Emails already counted this month (delivered or bounced).

per_ora.description: Hourly pace of the plan: above it messages wait in the queue, they are not rejected.

tracciamento.description: True if open and click tracking is active.

InvioRichiesta.description: One or more recipients (up to 50): each one gets their own copy. Italian names take precedence over the English aliases if you send both.

a.description: Recipient, or a list of up to 50 recipients.

da.description: Sender: must be on a verified domain of your account (subdomains are accepted).

html.description: HTML body. If the text part is missing, it is derived from the HTML.

rispondi_a.description: Reply-To address. Ignored if it is not a valid address.

intestazioni.description: Custom headers. Only `X-…` names pass (letters, digits and hyphens, max 40 characters after `X-`); others are dropped silently.

allegati.description: Up to 10 files and 10 MB in total (after decoding).

id_messaggio.description: Identifier given to the message; it is also its Message-ID (without angle brackets).

residuo.description: Estimate of the volume left this month.

oltre_il_piano.description: True if the included volume was used up and the email went out thanks to sending continuity.

tracciamento.description: Present instead of open/click when tracking is not active.

Evento.description: Log row. Treat ids as text; dates are UTC in `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` format.

code.description: Code returned by the recipient server, if any.

TipoEvento.description: `sent` accepted via API or form · `delivered` delivered · `bounce` permanent rejection · `defer` deferred, will retry · `complaint` spam report · `open`/`click` with tracking · `dropped` not sent because the recipient is on the suppression list.

email.description: Address, or a whole domain written `@domain.com`.

ModuloCampi.description: All the fields of your form (max 60, max 5,000 characters each). Names starting with `_` are reserved: only the listed ones are used, others are ignored. File uploads are not supported.

_subject.description: Subject of the email you receive.

_replyto.description: Reply address. If missing, the first field with «mail» in its name and a valid address is used.

_next.description: Thank-you page (full http/https address) for classic submissions.

_cc.description: Copy to another address, only if allowed in the form settings.

_gotcha.description: Honeypot field to keep empty and hidden: if filled, the submission is silently discarded.

_format.description: `plain` to receive the email as plain text.

nome.description: File name. Alias: `filename`. Executable files (.exe, .js, .bat…) are refused.

tipo.description: MIME type, for example application/pdf. Alias: `content_type`. Default: application/octet-stream.

errore.description: Sending server error or volume used up for that recipient.

segreto.description: Only in the POST response: `whsec_…`, to verify the signature.

EventoWebhook.description: Body of the POST we send to your address. Headers: X-MailSenpai-Event, X-MailSenpai-Delivery, X-MailSenpai-Signature (t=<unix>,v1=<HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<body>" with the secret>).

Sospeso.description: Account suspended (plan expired or unpaid, volume used up without continuity, spending cap reached…). The message states the reason.

example.errore: servizio sospeso: volume del mese esaurito. Controlla il tuo piano nell'area cliente.
